sessions.charter: Explore the header story cards with widths around 720/1024/1440 px, keyboard focus, hover and reduced motion to discover overlap, clipping and cycling/pause problems
notes: At 720 px one card is shown and fits between logo and basket.
At 1024 px three cards are shown; at 1440 px five cards are shown and nothing moves.
Cycling pauses on hover (D5) and changes cards without animation under reduced motion (D6).
Cycling did not pause while a card had keyboard focus (F1); after the fix focus pauses cycling.

sessions.charter: Explore the five story pages with keyboard and the accessibility snapshot to discover navigation, content-length and tone problems
notes: All five stories open from their card with Enter; h1 matches the card title.
Tone is cute and tongue-in-cheek, consistent with product copy (AC1 met).
Each product is linked from at least one story: Dehydrated Water (2), Tinfoil Thinking Cap (2), Canned Optimism (2).

sessions.charter: Explore basket and checkout with the new header on 720 and 1440 px to discover regressions caused by the shared header change
notes: Basket count stays correct across pages and reloads.
Checkout and thank-you message unaffected; no console errors besides the known favicon 404.

findings.title: Story cards keep cycling while a card has keyboard focus
steps: Open the shop at 1024 px wide
Press Tab until the first story card has focus
findings.expected: Cycling pauses while a card has focus (decision D5).
findings.actual: The focused card slides away and focus is lost.
findings.resolution: Added focusin/focusout handlers that pause and resume the timer; retested with the same steps in S1 – focus now pauses cycling.

findings.title: Long story title truncated at 721 px without a way to read it in full
steps: Open the shop at 721 px wide
Look at the single story card
findings.expected: The full story title is readable or available.
findings.actual: "The Great Calendar Reset" is shown as "The Great Calen…".

notExplored: Firefox and WebKit – the project tests Chromium only.
Screen widths below 720 px beyond a single check – story cards are out of scope there.
